content.text: In regions like Nigeria, Kenya, and the Philippines, digital creators face a stark reality: platforms like Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad are either unavailable or impose crippling restrictions. This post breaks down the exact [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-crypto-payments-tanzanian-online-sellers|architecture]] that solves this problem—a sovereign commerce stack using Solana payments, Cloudflare Workers, and NOWPayments. No platform lock-in. No 10% fees. Full ownership of your infrastructure.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/complete-deep-dive-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Solana payment

This is not a workaround. It’s a base-layer commerce infrastructure designed for creators in regions where conventional payment processors fail. The stack combines GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and NOWPayments for Solana-based transactions. The result? A fully automated digital product store where customers pay in SOL, USDT, or any of 300+ cryptocurrencies, and you retain 99.5% of every sale. Compare this to Gumroad’s 10% fee structure, and the savings are clear: at 100 sales per month of a $97 product, you retain an additional $921 annually. This architecture is pressure-tested in environments like Zimbabwe, where currency collapse and financial isolation are not theoretical risks but daily realities.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The stack operates in three layers. First, the frontend: your product page is hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages—both free and globally distributed. Second, the backend: Cloudflare Workers handle order processing, file delivery, and webhook logic. When a payment is made via NOWPayments, a webhook triggers the Worker to verify the transaction on-chain and deliver the product automatically. Third, the data layer: order details are stored in Supabase or Google Sheets, depending on your stack tier. Payments are settled directly to your Solana or preferred crypto wallet, bypassing intermediaries. The entire system is stateless—no customer data is stored on your servers, and you own the deployment keys. This design ensures that even if a component fails, the system remains operational.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This architecture is for digital creators who sell ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, or software and cannot rely on Stripe, PayPal, or platform-based solutions. It’s for creators in regions where financial infrastructure is either hostile or nonexistent. It’s for those who refuse to cede 10% of their revenue to platforms like Gumroad or Payhip. By deploying this stack, you eliminate platform fees, retain full data ownership, and gain infrastructure sovereignty. The system is designed to be low-maintenance: once deployed, it runs autonomously, with NOWPayments handling payment verification and Cloudflare Workers managing delivery. You focus on creating; the stack handles the commerce.
Retain 99.5% of every sale—compared to Gumroad’s 10% fee structure.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Each component is selected for its reliability and cost-efficiency. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages provide free, fast hosting with global CDN distribution. Cloudflare Workers execute backend logic at the edge, ensuring instant product delivery. Supabase or Google Sheets store order data securely, with Supabase offering advanced querying for scaled operations. NOWPayments processes crypto payments with a flat 0.5% fee, no KYC, and no buyer account requirements. Solana is recommended for its sub-$0.10 transaction fees, but the system supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. File delivery is handled via Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive, both scalable and cost-effective. The stack is modular: you can swap components as needed, but the default configuration is optimized for creators selling up to 1,000 products per month.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start with the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) if you’re new to this architecture, or deploy the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for advanced features like SPF/DKIM/DMARC email configuration. Both stacks are deployed within 48 hours, with 30-day support included. For those who prefer self-deployment, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides all 6 blueprints and 7 templates, available for instant download at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. Each blueprint includes step-by-step instructions, source code, and scaling playbooks. The kit is valued at $348 separately, making it the most cost-effective way to build and own your commerce infrastructure. Whether you choose a managed stack or self-deploy, the outcome is the same: a sovereign digital store that operates on your terms, not a platform’s.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook without PayPal or Stripe, deploy a sovereign commerce stack using Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, NOWPayments for crypto transactions, and GitHub Pages for hosting. This architecture automates payment verification and product delivery, ensuring you retain 99.5% of every sale. For example, selling a $97 ebook 100 times per month saves you $921 compared to Gumroad’s fees. The system supports Solana, USDT, and 300+ cryptocurrencies, with transaction fees under $0.10. Start with the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) or self-deploy using the Complete Builder Kit ($197).
Deploy in 48 hours with managed stacks or self-build with the Complete Builder Kit ($197).
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you’re selling notion templates, fonts, or digital downloads and want to accept USDT or Bitcoin without platform fees, this architecture is your solution. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all blueprints and templates needed to deploy a crypto-only digital store, available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. Whether you’re in Lagos, Manila, or Caracas, this stack ensures your commerce infrastructure is as sovereign as your creativity.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your stack tier: Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) or Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for managed deployment, or Complete Builder Kit ($197) for self-deployment. 2. Register a domain or use a GitHub Pages/Cloudflare Pages subdomain. 3. Set up a NOWPayments account and configure Solana or your preferred cryptocurrency. 4. Deploy the backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. 5. Upload your products to Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive for automated delivery. 6. Test the stack end-to-end: simulate a purchase, verify payment, and confirm file delivery. 7. Launch your store and monitor transactions via Supabase or Google Sheets.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not a developer?

Yes. The Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) and Edge Commerce Stack ($197) are deployed for you within 48 hours, with 30-day support included. If you prefer self-deployment, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides step-by-step blueprints and templates, requiring no coding expertise.
What happens if Solana transaction fees increase?

The stack supports 300+ cryptocurrencies via NOWPayments. If Solana fees rise, switch to BSC, TRON, or another low-fee network without altering the core architecture. The system is designed for flexibility.
How do I handle refunds in a crypto-only store?
Refunds are processed manually by sending the equivalent crypto amount back to the customer’s wallet. Document your refund policy clearly on your product page to manage expectations.
Can I scale this stack to handle thousands of sales per month?

Yes. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) includes Supabase for scalable order storage and Cloudflare Workers for edge processing. For higher volumes, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides a scaling playbook to optimize performance.
What if NOWPayments goes down?

The stack is designed to failover to a secondary payment processor if NOWPayments is unavailable. Alternatively, self-host a payment verification script using the blueprints in the Complete Builder Kit ($197).
